company.company description: Summit Dental Labs crafts custom dental restorations, including crowns, bridges, implant-supported dentures, and nighttime teeth guards. Using computer-aided design (CAD) and 3D printing, Summit provides precision-fit appliances to dental practices, offering overnight delivery in the Southeast and direct consultation services for challenging cases.
